USGS publishes incompatible boron product-form rows and an XX world total; no single production context is promoted.
The USGS MCS 2026 nonfuel data release does not publish a metallurgical-coal commodity chapter.
The selected row is titanium sponge metal. Mineral concentrates and TiO2 pigment remain separate USGS forms and are not combined.
The USGS MCS 2026 nonfuel data release does not publish uranium. Uranium has its own receipt-bounded Chamber.
Criticality is jurisdiction-, method-, and time-specific. This U.S. list is not a universal geological definition.
The list has 15 explicitly denoted rare-earth elements. Scandium remains a critical mineral here but is not counted among those 15 list markers.
Mineral commodities, elements, oxides, concentrates, metals, and baskets are not silently treated as interchangeable.
